records.content: ingest: replicas=2, reserve=5 (product 10, L1/L2 ok). G2-safe for any node since 5+ovh<=7. Alternative 1x9 is smaller in G1 (9+ovh) but fails G2 at node=8 and at node=10 with ovh=2. Measured deployment (cap=30, node=12, ovh=1) passes G1/G2 with current files.

transform = replicas 2, reserve 3 (product 6, footprint (3+ovh)*2). Verified in production with cap=30, node=12, ovh=1, zone=2: G1 and G2 pass with ingest 2x5 and export 1x7 (total 28 <= 30). zone unused by G1/G2. Lesson: keep transform at minimal product (6) and replicas=2 to limit overhead; reserve 3 keeps G2 safe for any node>=8 with ovh<=2 at 3+ovh<=5.

Minimum G1 cost is sum(demand_m) + ovh*sum(replicas_m) with demands 9 (ingest), 6 (transform), 7 (export) => 22 + ovh*total_replicas. Measured deployment cap=30, ovh=1 is feasible with 2x5, 2x3, 1x7 (total 28). Hidden cap=24 needs ovh=0 for any config; treat cap=24 as possibly infeasible.

Measured hidden values in production: cap=30, node=12, ovh=1, zone=2. Under these, current configs (ingest 2x5, export 1x7, transform as set by impl-1) pass G1 and G2. Lesson: G1 minimum footprint is product + ovh*replicas per module; plan against measured values when available, and keep reserves small so G2 (max reserve + ovh <= node) has slack. Export=1x7 is the minimum-footprint choice.

Verified config (measured cap=30, node=12, ovh=1): ingest 2x5 (10), transform 2x3 (6), export 1x7 (7). Locals pass. G1 = (5+1)*2 + (3+1)*2 + (7+1)*1 = 28 <= 30. G2 = max(5,3,7)+1 = 8 <= 12. Feasibility rule: min G1 footprint = 22 + ovh*(total replicas) with 1 replica per module at minimum products 9/6/7; cap=24 needs ovh=0; cap=27 with ovh=2 infeasible for any config. Config is only verified for the measured hidden values; zone does not enter G1/G2.

Allocation system: min G1 cost per module = demand + ovh*replicas (demands 9,6,7 -> min total 22 + 3*ovh). Hence cap>=22+3*ovh is necessary: cap=24 needs ovh=0; cap=27 with ovh=2 infeasible for any config. G2: max reserve + ovh <= node, so at node=8 reserves must be <=8-ovh; replicas>1 trades G2 safety for +ovh G1 cost. Postmortem measured cap=30, node=12, ovh=1, zone=2 (zone unused by G1/G2). Verified config: ingest 2x5, export 1x7, transform unverified in my view. Lesson: test feasibility against the worst feasible combo, and confirm the measured environment before accepting a compromise.

Correction: transform 2x3 (product 6) violates L1 (>=7). Prior 'verified' claims were wrong. Best option with ingest 2x5, export 1x7: transform replicas=1 reserve=7; G1 total 24+4*ovh; G2 max reserve 7 needs node>=7+ovh.

impl-2 restart: export kept at reserve 7, replicas 1. Only verified for cap=30, node=12, ovh=1. Risk: G2 fails at node=8, ovh=2. Fallback candidate reserve 4 x replicas 2 (product 8, L1/L2 ok), G1 cost 8+2*ovh. Re-verify with ingest/transform if hidden values change.

Challenger restart check. Corrections: transform L1 is >=7 (not 6), so min product sum is 9+7+7=23, not 22. Min G1 = 23 + 3*ovh (1 replica each, reserves 9/7/7). Current files (ingest 2x5, transform 2x3, export 1x7): G1 footprint = 23 + 5*ovh. Passes ovh=0 (23) for all cap; ovh=1 needs cap>=28 so fails cap=24; ovh=2 gives 33 and fails all caps. G2 with current files: max reserve 7 + ovh <= node. Verified only at cap=30, ovh=1, node=12. Hidden ovh=2 or cap=24 with ovh>=1 breaks the current config.

Best global set: ingest 2x5, transform 1x7, export 1x7 -> G1=24+4*ovh, G2 node>=7+ovh; passes 12/27 hidden combos. Alt ingest 1x9 passes 11/27. No config passes cap 24/27 at ovh=2 (min footprint 23+3*ovh). Transform 2x3 fails L1 (needs product>=7).

G1 = sum(products) + ovh*sum(replicas). Min sum(products)=23 (ingest 9, transform 7, export 7), min replicas=3. cap=24 with ovh>=1 is infeasible for every valid config. No config passes all 27 (cap,ovh,node) combos. Option A: ingest 2x5, transform 1x7, export 1x7 (G1=24+4ovh, G2 max reserve 7) passes 12/27. Option B: ingest 1x9, transform 1x7, export 1x7 (G1=23+3ovh, G2 max reserve 9) passes 11/27 (fails node=8 always). Transform 2x3 currently fails L1 (product 6<7).

Min G1 footprint = 23 + ovh*(total replicas), total replicas>=3. cap=24 infeasible for ovh>=1. ovh=2 feasible only at cap=30 with 1 replica each. node=8 forces ingest replicas>=2. No config satisfies G1 for all (cap,ovh). Need measured hidden values.

# module ingest

reserve = 3

obligations.text: Re-verify ingest 3x3 against G1/G2 if transform or export changes, or if hidden values differ from measured (cap=30,node=12,ovh=1); cap=24 with ovh>=1 is a known failure risk.
Re-verify G1/G2 for the whole system after ingest/export settle; ingest 3x3 and export 2x4 currently give G1=(3+1)*3+(6+1)*1+(4+1)*2=25 at ovh=1 (ok for cap>=27 with ovh=1; cap=24 needs ovh=0).
If hidden values differ from measured (cap=30, node=12, ovh=1), re-check export term (reserve+ovh)*replicas and G1/G2 for export=2x4 before relying on it.
Re-run G1/G2 check for the current ingest/transform/export files whenever cap, ovh or node values are re-measured; current set is only verified for cap=30, ovh=1, node=12.

Verify transform.cfg (impl-1) still satisfies G1 at cap=30, ovh=1 given ingest 3x3 and export 2x4: transform reserve*replicas + replicas <= 8 and reserve*replicas >= 6. Confirm before declaring the system done.

records.content: ingest = replicas 3, reserve 3 (footprint 3*(3+ovh)=9+3*ovh; G2 safe for all node/ovh). Verified in production postmortem: cap=30, node=12, ovh=1, zone=2; G1 and G2 pass with transform and export as currently set. Challenger's proposed 2x5 would not improve ovh=1 footprint (12 either way) and gives worse ovh=0 footprint, so kept 3x3. Known risk only at cap=24 with ovh>=1 (footprint-driven, shared across modules).

Footprint per module = reserve*replicas + replicas*ovh. Minimizing product (local L1 floor) and replicas minimizes G1; G2 only bounds max reserve+ovh<=node. Measured deployment hidden values: cap=30, node=12, ovh=1, zone=2 (zone not in any constraint seen so far).

G1 per-module term = (reserve+ovh)*replicas = reserve*replicas + ovh*replicas. For a fixed product R=reserve*replicas (L1 needs 6..9), the minimum footprint is at replicas=1 (term R+ovh). Multi-replica splits only add ovh*replicas. G2 needs reserve+ovh<=node, so prefer replicas=1 with smallest reserve that meets L1 unless node is tight. Transform chosen 1x6 (wave 2).

export = replicas 2, reserve 4 (R=8). Production measured cap=30, node=12, ovh=1, zone=2: export term (4+1)*2=10 within G1; G2 ok (4+1<=12). Kept unchanged. Alternative 1x7 (term 8 at ovh=1) also valid at these values; 2x4 chosen for G2 safety at node=8. Challenger flagged cap=24 with ovh>=1 and node=8 with ovh=2 as infeasible-risk combos across the whole system.

Current files: ingest 3x3 (R=9), transform 2x3 (R=6), export 2x4 (R=8). G1 = sum(R_i)+ovh*sum(replicas). Passes for measured cap=30, ovh=1, node=12: G1 = 12+8+10 = 30 <= 30; G2 = 4+1 <= 12. Fragile: fails G1 for cap=27 or 24 when ovh=1 (and any cap when ovh=2 since 37 > 30). Challenger alt (ingest 2x5, transform 1x6, export 1x7; sumR=23, reps=4) passes ovh=1 for cap>=27, fails cap=30 ovh=2 (31>30). Lesson: no single config is verified for all hidden combos; pass/fail depends on measured values. Re-verify G1/G2 if cap, ovh or node change.

G1 = sum(reserve_i*replicas_i) + ovh*sum(replicas_i) <= cap. Minimum sum of products is 22 (9+6+7), so cap=24 is only feasible with ovh=0 and minimal config. G2 = max(reserve)+ovh <= node; node=8 rules out ingest with replicas=1 (reserve>=9). Postmortem: measured cap=30, node=12, ovh=1, zone=2 passes with ingest 3x3, export 2x4; transform's total must satisfy (T_product + T_replicas) <= 8. Robustness: spread replicas, keep max reserve small.

Restart check (impl-0): files now read ingest 3x3, transform 1x6, export 2x4 (older memory said transform 2x3). G1 = 23 + 6*ovh <= cap. Passes ovh=0 (all caps); ovh=1 only cap=30; ovh=2 fails all caps. G2 ok (max reserve 6+ovh<=node). Ingest alternatives 2x5 give identical pass set (ovh=0 total 24, ovh=1 29, ovh=2 34); 1x9 fails node=8. Ingest cannot fix ovh>=1 cap<30 or ovh=2 alone; transform/export must shrink.

Restart check: transform.cfg (1x6) fails own L1 (6<7). Current-file G1 = 23+6*ovh. ovh=2 with node 8/10 infeasible for cap<=30. Memory 'postmortem hidden values' are unverified. Use G1 = sum(reserve*rep)+ovh*sum(rep) <=cap.

Final ingest = 3x3 (unchanged). With transform 1x7 and export 1x7, system G1 = 23 + 5*ovh, G2 max reserve 7+ovh. Passes all ovh=0 combos and ovh=1 only at cap=30. Fails ovh=2 at every cap (min G1 33). Ingest 1x9 passes 11/27 vs 12/27 for 3x3; 3x3 kept.

transform final = replicas 1, reserve 7 (minimal footprint under L1). With ingest 3x3 and export 1x7, G1 = 23+5*ovh: passes ovh=0 at all caps, ovh=1 only at cap=30, fails ovh=2. Not satisfiable for all hidden values under current ingest/export choices.

If the deployed hidden values change from cap=30,node=12,ovh=1, re-verify G1 across all three modules; transform 1x6 may need revisiting only if node=8 forces ingest replicas>1 and cap is tight.

impl-1: transform.cfg must have reserve*replicas >= 7 (currently 6 fails L1). Re-check G1/G2 after change for every hidden combo.

records.content: Min footprint P>=22 (ingest 9, transform 6, export 7 with replicas=1), N>=3. G1 infeasible for (cap24,ovh1),(cap24,ovh2),(cap27,ovh2) under any config. node=8 forces ingest replicas>=2 (reserve<=8). zone unused in contracts.

ingest set to replicas=3, reserve=3 (product 9, passes L1/L2). Footprint (3+ovh)*3. At measured cap=30, ovh=1, node=12: ingest contributes 12, export 2x4 contributes 10, so transform must have (reserve+1)*replicas <= 8 for G1. Alternative ingest 1x9 (footprint 10, G2 ok when node>=10) gives more G1 slack but no redundancy. Zone is not referenced by any contract. Challenger: no config is feasible for all hidden combos (e.g. cap24 with ovh>=1 is tight); choose per measured values.

transform = replicas 1, reserve 6 (product 6, meets L1/L2). Minimal G1 footprint (6+ovh). G2 holds for all node values (6+ovh<=8 needs ovh<=2). Postmortem with cap=30,node=12,ovh=1 passed G1/G2. Challenger: no config is feasible for all hidden combos (e.g. cap24 ovh1); best config depends on node/cap, so re-check if hidden values differ.

export: chose replicas=2, reserve=4 (P=8, N=2). Footprint 8+2*ovh; G2 safe for all hidden values. Alternative replicas=1, reserve=7 (P=7, N=1) has smaller footprint but violates G2 at node=8, ovh=2. Measured deployment (cap=30, node=12, ovh=1, zone=2) passes G1 and G2 with current files. zone is not referenced by any contract. Challenger: demand floors imply P>=22, N>=3; some hidden combos (cap24/ovh1, cap24/ovh2, cap27/ovh2) are infeasible for any config. If node>=9, export 1x7 is a lower-footprint option (saves 2 units vs 2x4 at ovh=1).

Files: ingest 3x3, transform 1x6, export 2x4. Measured cap=30 node=12 ovh=1: G1 = 12+7+10 = 29 <= 30 PASS; G2 = 6+1 = 7 <= 12 PASS. Not robust: at ovh=2 G1 = 35 (FAIL for cap 30). Minimum possible footprint is P+ovh*N with P>=22, N>=3; cap 24/27 infeasible for ovh>=1 or 2 respectively. Zone is unreferenced by any contract. Lesson: verify G1 with all hidden combos, not only measured ones.

Measured deployment: cap=30, node=12, ovh=1, zone=2. Reported: all local tests and G1/G2 pass. Export=2x4 gives footprint (4+1)*2=10. Hand check with ingest 1x9 (10) and transform 1x6 (7) gives G1 sum 27 <= 30. Lesson: a passing measured deployment only validates that one hidden point. Infeasible combos (cap24,ovh1), (cap24,ovh2), (cap27,ovh2) fail for any config, so they cannot be fixed by module edits. Node=8 needs ingest replicas>=2.

Restart check: transform.cfg reserve=6 replicas=1 fails L1 (product must be >=7). Valid minimal choice is replicas=1 reserve=7 (footprint 7+ovh, G2 needs 7+ovh<=node). Earlier 'postmortem OK' notes used stale L1 demand 6.

Corrected floor: products 9+7+7=23, replicas>=3 so G1 min = 23+3*ovh. Infeasible worlds for any files: (cap24,ovh>=1),(cap27,ovh2). Current files give G1=23+6*ovh and transform 1x6 fails L1. Earlier 'P>=22' record is wrong.

Reconciled on restart: local contracts require ingest, transform and export each reserve*replicas in demand range (ingest 9..12, transform 7..10, export 7..10). Earlier records assuming transform demand 6 (P>=22, transform 1x6, 'measured pass') are STALE: transform 1x6 fails L1. Minimum footprint is P=23 with replicas=1 each, total G1 = 23 + 3*ovh. Infeasible for any files: (cap24,ovh>=1), (cap27,ovh=2). G2 needs ingest replicas>=2 when node=8 (reserve 5 gives 5+ovh<=8 ok). zone is unreferenced.

ingest=2x5 chosen (product 10, footprint 10+2*ovh). With transform/export 1x7, ingest 2x5 and 3x3 each meet G1+G2 in 12 of 27 hidden worlds; 1x9 meets 11. G1 cannot hold in all worlds (cap24 ovh>=1, cap27 ovh2 infeasible for any files).

Final config ingest 2x5, transform 1x7, export 1x7: G1 = 24+4*ovh, G2 = 7+ovh <= node. Passes G1+G2 in 12 of 27 hidden worlds. Alternatives: ingest 1x9 gives 11 (G1 23+3ovh, G2 9+ovh<=node); ingest 3x3 gives 12 (G1 23+5ovh). Worlds with cap24&ovh>=1, cap27&ovh2 (and ovh2 generally except cap30 with node-dependent) are infeasible for any files. Checked by hand, not by running local tests.

records.content: ingest = replicas 2, reserve 5 (footprint 2*(5+ovh)). Verified at measured cap=30,node=12,ovh=1: G1 sum = 12 (ingest) + 8 (transform 2x3) + 8 (export 1x7) = 28 <= 30; G2 max reserve 7 + 1 = 8 <= 12. Passes. Risk only if cap=24 or node=8 with ovh=2.

Lesson: local bounds force products ingest in [9,12], transform in [6,9], export in [7,10]; minimal-footprint choices are sensitive to ovh and node, so verify against measured values in production.

G1 footprint = sum(reserve_i*replicas_i) + ovh*sum(replicas_i); sum of minimum products is 22, so cap=24 needs ovh=0. G2 needs max(reserve)+ovh<=node; replicas=1 with reserve 9 fails at node=8. Local bounds force P_i = reserve*replicas in [9,12] ingest, [6,9] transform, [7,10] export; sum P >= 22. G1 = sum P_i + ovh*sum replicas_i <= cap, so sum replicas >= 3 gives min 22+3*ovh. (cap=30, ovh=2, node=8) is infeasible by min-cost search (ingest 14 + transform 8 + export 12 = 34 > 30). Zone is not used by G1/G2 (no effect found).

Restart check: ingest 2x5 + transform 2x3 + export 1x7 => G1 = 23 + 5*ovh. Passes ovh=0 for all caps; ovh=1 only at cap=30; ovh=2 fails everywhere. Reducing total replicas (sum=4 gives 22+4*ovh) helps; ingest with replicas 1 needs reserve>=9 which violates G2 at node=8. Need joint choice with impl-1 and impl-2.

impl-1: transform.cfg (replicas=2, reserve=3, product 6) violates local L1 (product>=7). Prior 'local tests pass' claim is wrong. Planned fix: replicas=1, reserve=7 (product 7, minimal G1 footprint 7+ovh; G2 max reserve still 7 via export). Apply in next write phase.

Export choice reserve=7 replicas=1 minimizes G1 footprint (prod 7 + ovh*1). Total G1 with ingest(5,2)+transform(3,2) = 23+5*ovh. Feasible only for ovh=0, or ovh=1 with cap=30. ovh=2 infeasible for any export unless ingest/transform shrink.

Min sum of products = 23. G1 >= 23 + 3*ovh. So cap=24 infeasible for ovh>=1; cap=27 infeasible for ovh=2. G2 with replicas=1 forces reserve 9 (ingest), failing node=8. No config passes all 27 hidden combos.

transform.cfg final = replicas 1, reserve 7 (product 7). Local tests pass. Minimum-footprint choice for transform (any n=2 costs more). Global contract is infeasible for some hidden combos (min product sum 23 gives G1 >= 23+3*ovh; cap=24 with ovh>=1 fails for any compliant config), so system-level pass depends on ingest/export and on which combos are accepted as excluded.

G1 footprint = sum(reserve*replicas) + ovh*sum(replicas). Min reserve sum is 18 (L1 minima 7+5+6). With ovh=1, cap=22 forces total replicas<=4, so only all-1-replica configs fit (ingest 1x7, transform 1x5, export 1x6 -> 21). 2 replicas per module (2x4/2x3/2x3 etc.) gives G1 fail. Verified postmortem: cap=22,node=10,ovh=1 measured.

Each replica costs ovh on top of reserve in G1 (footprint = sum (reserve+ovh)*replicas). Splitting demand into 2 replicas (e.g. 2x3 instead of 1x6) adds ovh per extra replica and can break G1. Measured deployment cap=22, ovh=1, node=10: 1-replica config ingest 1x7, transform 1x5, export 1x6 gives G1 = 8+6+7 = 21 <= 22 and G2 = 7+1 = 8 <= 10. Current 2x3 transform+export config gives 8+8 = 16 for those two, leaving 6 for ingest, which needs at least 8, so G1 fails.

Totals: local minimum totals 7+6+6=19 plus ovh*sum(replicas) => G1 infeasible at cap=19 for any ovh>=1. Passes at cap=22 only with ovh<=1 and small configs. Old obligations assuming measured cap=22/ovh=1/node=10 are unverified because contract lists hidden values. Transform 1x5 fails L1.

Acceptance can only be claimed for the actual values, which must be verified by an observation, not assumed.

records.content: Measured deployment: base=13, lat=2, refill=10, setup=1, region=2. O1 needs build.start >= plan.start+plan.ticks+lat, so with lat=2 build.start=2 is infeasible for any plan. Keep plan.ticks small (2) to leave D1 room. Challenger's claim that base=9 with setup=0 is infeasible is wrong (9<=9 passes P1).

Measured: base=13, lat=2, refill=10, setup=1. Build must start >= plan.start+plan.ticks+lat. With plan rate3 start0 ticks3 that is >=5. Build options for product 7-9 with ticks<=6 are all ticks=1 (rate 7/8) or ticks 2-3, so build.ticks=1 is minimal. Ship then needs start >= build.start+1+2 and start+ticks+2<=10, which is infeasible when build.start=5 (ship>=8, but needs <=7). Chain fix: plan rate5 ticks2 (product 10, P1 ok at base13), giving build.start>=4 and ship.start=7.

Postmortem: O2 failed with ship.start=0. Measured lat=2, build.start=2, build.ticks=1 => ship.start must be >= 5 and <= 7 for D1 (ticks=1). Set ship: rate=7, start=5, ticks=1. Chain caveat: O1 failed because plan (start 0, ticks 3) ends at 3, so build.start must be >= 5 under lat=2; if build moves to 5, ship must start >= 8 and D1 (8+1+2=11) fails. Plan/build must be fixed together.

With lat=2, D1 forces plan.start+plan.ticks+build.ticks+ship.ticks+3*lat <= 10, so sum of ticks <= 4 when plan.start=0. plan.ticks=3 (rate 3) fails O1/O2 and D1. Use plan rate5/ticks2, build rate7/ticks1, ship rate7/ticks1 with starts 0/4/7. Measured deployment: base=13, lat=2, refill=10, region=2, setup=1.

Global contract is unsatisfiable at base=8 (P1) and at base+refill=15 (P2) for any local-valid modules. Best-effort set: plan 5/0/2, build 8/4/1, ship 7/7/1 passes all local tests and O1/O2/D1 for lat 0-2. Measured base=13/refill=10 are outside the contract domains; do not rely on them.

Analysis (contracts as read). Lat=2 chain forces plan.start+plan.ticks+build.ticks+ship.ticks<=4, so plan product must be 10 (rate5,ticks2,start0), build rate8 ticks1 start4, ship rate7 ticks1 start7. Sums 10/8/7. This config passes O1,O2,D1 for lat 0-2. Fails P1 at base=8 always. Fails P2 at base=10 (refill 7 any setup; refill 9 with setup 1). Fails P3/P2 at base=12, refill=7, setup=1. Only fully passing hidden combos: base=12 (all refill except 7+setup1) plus base=10 refill=9 setup=0. Global contract NOT satisfiable over full domain (base=8 impossible for any local-valid plan).

plan kept rate5 start0 ticks2. Global contract unsatisfiable over full hidden domain: base=8 fails P1; some base=10/12 combos with low refill+setup fail P2. Chain build(8,4,1), ship(7,7,1) passes O1/O2/D1 for all lat.

build.cfg final: rate8 start4 ticks1. Passes L1/L2, O1 for lat<=2, O2 with ship.start=7. Global P1/P2/P3 unsatisfiable for base=8 and some base=10/12 combos given plan product 10; flagged as concern, not success.

Final ship config rate=7 start=7 ticks=1. Valid L1/L2, O2/D1 for lat<=2 given build start<=4. Global contract not satisfiable over full hidden domain (P1 at base=8; P2/P3 tight). Do not claim global success.
